entry.title: Cloud AI is not AI — it's a service you rent
entry.summary: When people talk about AI today, they are not talking about artificial intelligence. They are talking about a service. You send a prompt to a server. The server runs a model. The model returns text. You pay per token. This is not intelligence. This is a utility — like electricity or water. Real intelligence does not live in a data center. It does not depend on an API key. It does not stop working when the internet goes down. Real intelligence is local. It is sovereign. It is owned by the user. Cloud AI is a product. You rent access to a model that you do not control. You do not own the model. You cannot modify it. You cannot see its weights. You cannot verify what it has learned. You do not control the data.
